beats.say: A spider with legs four inches across is running across your floor.
It can run about half a meter every second.
The giant house spider. It lives in garages and basements.
It spins a flat web with a funnel, and waits inside it.
In late summer and fall, the males wander, looking for females.
That's why you find them stuck in your bathtub, looking for water.
Venomous? Yes. But its bite isn't known to threaten people. It would rather run.
